scope: Value-delta identity for the existing fixed known cargo continuation; not a Native-state equivalence or a new route/claim policy.

kept.actor: All owner fields except raw score, scoreSources and token records; retain wallet, exact hand/reserved card instances, task count, tech, income and company runtime flags. Retain validated pool count.
kept.world: Full turn, pieces, solar geometry and final-scoring board; all transport jobs and their exact fossil records, panel slots/unlocks; forbiddenCoordinate.
kept.knowledge: Eligibility requires every owner hand/reserved instance known; visibleRootCargo and printed reward/card definitions remain local to the unchanged analysis root. No future unknown fossil is priced.

omitted.proof: The fixed corner/claim only append discard/remove IDs. No accepted continuation draws or acquires cards, and allowed endgame rules do not read card history. The current exact hand/reserved runtime instances remain in the key.

omitted.fields: meta sequences and data token identity/placement records
omitted.proof: gainData uses pool count and valid unique slot occupancy for capacity; getNextDataIndex and dataToken sequence allocate labels only. No fixed cargo action places/analyzes data, and no Native successor is cached. Validate pool/resource count and legal slots before keying.

omitted.fields: scan boards, sector wins, planet/trace scoring context
omitted.proof: moveProbe arrival rewards change publicity/visit events, never orbit/landing markers; accepted fixed claims have no spawned scan effects. Gold b2 and the three allowed endgame-rule terms remain unchanged across the continuation. Native blue unlock writes panel/unlocked positions and does not write trace markers; listTraceEntries counts trace entries without unlock filtering. Rebase the full current score on every cache hit.

omitted.fields: other players and match context beyond initialSetup
omitted.proof: augmentEffectResult resolves the explicit owner and their triggers/bonuses. Pure gain/data task rewards and the fixed one-move corner do not consult another player's wallet/cards or the previous main-card context. All other players have passed; owner triggers and turn bonuses are excluded.

Native final score is additive without Jiuzhe penalty; the key excludes that penalty, any pending owner trigger and unsupported endgame-rule kinds. Every gold mark is already recorded. Native end-game scoring does not read scoreSources.

guards: Round4 current owner, main completed, other seats passed, fixed DeepSpace company, no borrowed tech/turn bonus/trigger/ordinary probe, only revealed Worm and Amiba, valid known owner cards and data pool, all gold marks, allowed endgame rules only. Unsupported contexts retain the original function.
hypotheses: Compact dependency key yields enough additional reuse at lower cost
Counterfactual differences in ignored fields preserve marginal result while relevant inputs split the key
beforeImplementation: Run one uncached identity diagnostic. Whole graph/roots, gain/plans and current-value rebasing must remain exact; net removable work must credibly cover39.7ms with margin. Reject before coding if not supported.
requiredControls: Six prior Native payoffs, score/scan/token-label rebasing, wallet/hand/geometry/forbidden-coordinate changes, unknown card, trigger, unsupported endgame/alien and invalid pool fallback; source/RNG isolation and result mutation safety.
budgetsAndCoverage: Runtime budgets remain null; no node/branch/depth/beam cap. Any cache eviction recomputes the same function and must not omit plans. No new game or batch.
stop: At most60 minutes or the two hypotheses. One scoped prototype only if diagnosis and required controls support it; one final-source admission decision, no timing retries.
